committee_annual_consolidation.publication_rule: Create one annual master per committee and calendar year, titled in the form 'GAATC Minutes 2023', rather than publishing each short monthly record as a separate visible link.
committee_annual_consolidation.coverage_expansion: Inventory every other year represented by GAATC, GABAC, or GARTC records and add one annual compilation task for each year with substantive surviving records.

missing_minutes_rule.introductory_explanation: The annual master must explain that when exhaustive official-source review found no approved minutes for a scheduled meeting but found the official agenda, the agenda is included to preserve the available meeting record.
missing_minutes_rule.presentation_limit: The table of contents, separator, and document description must identify the item as an agenda; it must not be described as approved minutes or silently substituted for them.
missing_minutes_rule.exclusions: Do not include an agenda when approved minutes are available, or for an officially cancelled or no-quorum meeting.
missing_minutes_rule.verification: Check the committee's official calendar, archive, OnBase records, adjacent meeting approvals, cancellations, and quorum evidence before applying the label.

committee_annual_consolidation.preservation_rule: Retain and verify every included original separately in R2 and inventory; the annual master is the visible browsing record, not a replacement for source-level provenance.

execution_order: Finish the currently checkpointed historical-studies and impact-fee batch, then perform the Capital Spending consolidation cleanup before expanding the committee annual-master series. This roadmap may be reordered if page clutter becomes the immediate priority, but no unresolved version family may be silently flattened.
